question: Is the historical-block value non-deterministic per RUN (as first reported) or per TREE?
method: Same commit 7f13b90. Three consecutive runs of "python -B tools/perf_budget.py --check" in (a) a FRESH CLONE of that commit and (b) the AUTHORING working tree at that commit; compared with the committed artifact .hgk/artifacts/s2/PERF_BUDGET.json.
finding: PER-RUN variance is NOT reproduced: within one tree the value is stable across repeated runs. The value IS tree/corpus-dependent: 368432 in a clean clone of the published commit vs 343547 in the authoring worktree, while the committed record says 343547.
correction: My earlier framing ("the value changes every run": 366299 then 365351) was WRONG and is withdrawn. Those two numbers came from two DIFFERENT checkouts (the AO single-branch clone vs my packed clone), not from two runs of one checkout. The independent lanes were right to push back.
defect_status: UNCHANGED AND STRENGTHENED. The historical block reads no stored value back, so a row labelled "the recorded verdicts are preserved verbatim and must never be rewritten" prints a number that moves when the checkout moves: 343547 / 365351 / 368432 across three trees at the same product content. That is a record that is not a record.

corroboration.structural: WS-B: no code path reads .hgk/artifacts/s2/PERF_BUDGET.json (write-only, line ~260); grep 343547 finds it only in the line-33 comment.
corroboration.companion_drift: WS-C: the committed artifact record vs live differs on other rows too - sizes.pd 2447 committed vs 1385 live; timing rows compile_chain_ms 818.2 committed vs 707-805 live.
corroboration.test_gap: WS-C: tests/test_perf_budget.py hardcodes 343547.0 (line ~67) and asserts only the metric NAME in preserved_fails (line ~108), so it cannot catch this class.
